purpose: PetBot experimental training projects. Code is versioned on dedicated demoproj branches; checkouts are managed by default.xml.

repositories.name: recovery_agile_01
repositories.local_validation: PhysX stochastic standing 64/64; GPU probability/gradient/export checks; B/C 128 envs x 100 iteration and checkpoint reload passed. Independent untrained stochastic control 87/512 success, 84/512 stable. Training library 16384 with 2489 recoverable fallen curriculum samples. See docs/petbot_sweep3_training.md and PETBOT_SWEEP_03.md.

repositories.name: jump_rl_demo
repositories.local_validation: Front wheels can lift. Rear-wheel hop raised the rear-wheel center of mass by 0.8 mm, so the full jump was abandoned on 2026-10-15. See docs/jump_prestudy.md.

repositories.name: upright_rl_demo
repositories.local_validation: Reference behavior is robot_controller_demo/jump_demo. It holds the front wheels up and is too stiff to use as training data. See docs/upright.md.
